name: On Mount Ségou
source:
There was a long-held belief,
In the Azurium Air Fleet
of the Mogho Naaba.

It was said...
That good fortune would come to a newly-wed captain,
If she took her bride far, far below the cloud layers,
To offer a heartfelt prayer,
To the Nameless One, on Mount Ségou.


[from [url=https://rastagong.itch.io/on-mount-segou]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一直以来有一个信念，
在Azurium空军中
莫戈纳巴人的。

据说…
好运会降临到新婚的船长身上，
如果她带着她的新娘远远低于云层，
献上衷心的祈祷，
致塞古山上的无名者。


[来自[url=https://rastagong.itch.io/on-mount-segou]itch.io[/url]]
